arguments:
{"script":"set -e
mkdir -p temp_workspace
cp /root/matrix.txt temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt
size=$(stat -c%s temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt)
sha=$(sha256sum temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt | cut -d" " -f1)
printf 'size=%s
sha256=%s
' "$size" "$sha" > temp_workspace/matrix_copy.metadata
cd temp_workspace
perl -e 'open F,"<","matrix_copy.txt"; $pos=0; while(defined($line=<F>)){print $pos,"\n"; $pos+=length($line);} ' > matrix_lines.idx
last=$(tail -n1 matrix_lines.idx)
if [ "$last" -ge "$size" ]; then echo "INDEX_COVERAGE_ERROR" >&2; exit 1; fi
wc -l < matrix_copy.txt
"}
